text:
sara-marketing: Heads-up: one live "Virtual Launch Office Hours" on 2026-07-14. Need reg page (EN/FR/JP), Zoom template, caption workflow, clip pipeline, and lead routing. Can we split owners?
theo-ops: I9ll own Zoom/webhook + S3 flow. Quick Q: passcode on or off? Passcode reduces spam but drops conversion.
emi-growth: Off for marketing. Use unique email-only join links and attr honeypot instead. Reg form should capture locale, intent (benchmark|demo|partner), and subtitle preference.
nora-analytics: HubSpot mapping required: utm_campaign -> Original_Source, intent -> Event_Intent, locale -> Lead_Locale. Also want `event_engagement` number after processing (0-100).
sara-marketing: Consent copy draft: "Yes, send me short highlights and follow-ups from Redwood Inference." Single checkbox, link to privacy and unsubscribe in follow-ups. Legal OK?
legal: That language is fine; include privacy link and a contact for opt-out in emails. Keep checkbox unchecked by default.
clip-bot: clip-bot: After upload, we9ll auto-generate VTT and 3-5 highlight clips using speaker turns + keyword salience. Clips saved to s3://marketing-events/launch2026/{locale}/full/ and processed under /clips/. Emit SNS:topic clip-ready.
video-team: We can do 20-30s lead_spark trims per locale in <36h if auto-clips exist. Request: include `locale` and `subtitle_needed` in metadata so we know where to burn captions.
theo-ops: Agreed naming: `{event_id}/{locale}/{YYYYMMDD}/clip_{n}_{start_ms}_{end_ms}.mp4` with sidecar `{same-name}.json` containing flat keys only. Retention: raw 90d, processed clips 365d.
hubspot-bot: hubspot-bot: Custom fields created: Event_Intent, Lead_Locale, Event_Engagement. Zapier webhook template ready for form -> HubSpot contact creation.
nora-analytics: Routing rules: event_engagement >=75 and company_size >=50 -> AE immediate task; 50-74 -> SDR queue; <50 -> nurture cadence. Also include `preferred_contact_time` from reg form for scheduling.
emi-growth: Follow-ups: immediate thank-you + calendar link; 24h localized highlight email with 2 clips; 48h AE outreach for high-priority; 7d nurture. Also we should A/B test subject lines per locale.
sara-marketing: For replays: we9ll publish gated replay packages per locale with 3 clips + full recording. Clips visible to users who consented. Non-consenting regs get text-only recap.
opsbot: opsbot: Webhook created. Zoom cloud recording -> S3 path: `marketing-events/launch2026/{locale}/full/{meeting_id}.mp4`. Will trigger clip pipeline on upload.
clip-bot: clip-bot: Metadata published includes `clip_priority` (high|normal), `subtitle_needed` (true|false), `start_ms`, `end_ms`, `speakers`, `keywords`, `engagement_score`.
video-team: Please mark AE clips with clip_priority=high. We will trim, add intro card, and attach to SFDC Lead as file when AE delivery triggered.
nora-analytics: Also compute `watched_full` boolean if watch_pct>90 and set `event_engagement` accordingly. Push final score to HubSpot and SFDC via our integration.
sara-marketing: Final owners: theo -> Zoom/webhook + S3; emi -> reg pages + follow-up templates; nora -> analytics + routing; video-team -> trims & AE delivery. Legal to approve copy. I9ll drop EN/FR/JP reg copy tonight. Any blockers?
theo-ops: No blockers. I9ll provision Zoom meeting template and post test link.
hubspot-bot: hubspot-bot: Zapier test webhook created 2026-06-02 09:05 UTC. Contact creation flow validated.
sara-marketing: Great thanks team :sparkles: Keep this thread for assets and test results."
